mapModals.whenFirstTurnedOnThe: When first turned on, the whole map starts covered; reveal it with the fog brush in the toolbar. You see it semi-transparent; the players see it opaque. Turning it off doesn't erase what was revealed.
mapView.clickTheMapToPlace: Click the map to place a marker. Esc to exit.
mapView.clickAddANodeClicking: Click: add a node (clicking an existing node connects it). Alt+click: curve point, without creating a node. With Shift, in a straight line from the previous point. Enter or Esc to finish.
mapView.zoneClickToAddVertices: Zone: click to add vertices (with auto-anchoring, near a node or another vertex they snap to it). With Shift, in a straight line from the previous one. Click the first one or press Enter to close it. Esc to cancel.
mapView.clickTwoNodesToCalculate: Click two nodes to calculate the distance along the visible routes (or two points if the map has a scale; with Shift, the second one aligned with the first).
mapView.laserMoveTheCursorTo: Laser: move the cursor to point; hold the click and drag to draw (it fades). Right-click and drag: move the map. Esc to exit.
mapView.penHoldTheClickAnd: Pen: hold the click and drag to draw. Drawings aren't saved: they're cleared when Obsidian closes. Right-click and drag: move the map. Esc to exit.
mapView.eraserClickOrDragOver: Eraser: click or drag over a stroke to erase it. Right-click the eraser button: clear all. Right-click and drag: move the map. Esc to exit.
mapView.fogHoldTheClickAnd: Fog: hold the click and drag to reveal or cover (choose it in the toolbar, with the brush size). Right-click and drag: move the map. Esc to exit.
mapView.clickTwoPointsWhoseReal: Click two points whose real distance you know (with Shift, the second one aligned with the first).
mapView.clickTheMapOrAnother: Click the map (or another marker) to set the portal / stairs destination; the current zoom is saved too.
mapView.itDoesntContainAJson: It doesn't contain a JSON object.

srd.condition.blinded.name: Blinded
srd.condition.blinded.1.title: Can't See
srd.condition.blinded.1.text: You can't see and automatically fail any ability check that requires sight.
srd.condition.blinded.2.title: Attacks Affected
srd.condition.blinded.2.text: Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.
srd.condition.bloodied.name: Bloodied
srd.condition.bloodied.1.text: A creature is Bloodied while it has half its Hit Points or fewer remaining.
srd.condition.dead.name: Dead
srd.condition.dead.1.text: A dead creature has no Hit Points and can't regain them unless it is first revived by magic such as the Raise Dead or Revivify spell. When such a spell is cast, the spirit knows who is casting it and can refuse. The spirit of a dead creature has left the body and departed for the Outer Planes, and reviving the creature requires calling the spirit back.
srd.condition.dead.2.title: Instant Death
srd.condition.dead.2.text: If damage reduces you to 0 Hit Points and the remaining damage equals or exceeds your Hit Point maximum, you die.
srd.condition.concentration.name: Concentration
srd.condition.concentration.1.text: Some spells and other effects require Concentration to remain active, as specified in their descriptions. If the effect's creator loses Concentration, the effect ends. If the effect has a maximum duration, the effect's description specifies how long the creator can concentrate on it: up to 1 minute, 1 hour, or some other duration. The creator can end Concentration at any time (no action required). The following factors break Concentration.
srd.condition.concentration.2.title: Another Concentration Effect
srd.condition.concentration.2.text: You lose Concentration on an effect the moment you start casting a spell that requires Concentration or activate another effect that requires Concentration.
srd.condition.concentration.3.title: Damage
srd.condition.concentration.3.text: If you take damage, you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw to maintain Concentration. The DC equals 10 or half the damage taken (round down), whichever number is higher, up to a maximum DC of 30.
srd.condition.concentration.4.title: Incapacitated or Dead
srd.condition.concentration.4.text: Your Concentration ends if you have the Incapacitated condition or you die.
srd.condition.charmed.name: Charmed
srd.condition.charmed.1.title: Can't Harm the Charmer
srd.condition.charmed.1.text: You can't attack the charmer or target the charmer with damaging abilities or magical effects.
srd.condition.charmed.2.title: Social Advantage
srd.condition.charmed.2.text: The charmer has Advantage on any ability check to interact with you socially.
srd.condition.deafened.name: Deafened
srd.condition.deafened.1.title: Can't Hear
srd.condition.deafened.1.text: You can't hear and automatically fail any ability check that requires hearing.
srd.condition.exhaustion.name: Exhaustion
srd.condition.exhaustion.1.title: Exhaustion Levels
srd.condition.exhaustion.1.text: This condition is cumulative. Each time you receive it, you gain 1 Exhaustion level. You die if your Exhaustion level is 6.
srd.condition.exhaustion.2.title: D20 Tests Affected
srd.condition.exhaustion.2.text: When you make a D20 Test, the roll is reduced by 2 times your Exhaustion level.
srd.condition.exhaustion.3.title: Speed Reduced
srd.condition.exhaustion.3.text: Your Speed is reduced by a number of feet equal to 5 times your Exhaustion level.
srd.condition.exhaustion.4.title: Removing Exhaustion Levels
srd.condition.exhaustion.4.text: Finishing a Long Rest removes 1 of your Exhaustion levels. When your Exhaustion level reaches 0, the condition ends.
srd.condition.frightened.name: Frightened
srd.condition.frightened.1.title: Ability Checks and Attacks Affected
srd.condition.frightened.1.text: You have Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is within line of sight.
srd.condition.frightened.2.title: Can't Approach
srd.condition.frightened.2.text: You can't willingly move closer to the source of fear.
srd.condition.grappled.name: Grappled
srd.condition.grappled.1.title: Speed 0
srd.condition.grappled.1.text: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
srd.condition.grappled.2.title: Attacks Affected
srd.condition.grappled.2.text: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls against any target other than the grappler.
srd.condition.grappled.3.title: Movable
srd.condition.grappled.3.text: The grappler can drag or carry you when it moves, but every foot of movement costs it 1 extra foot unless you are Tiny or two or more sizes smaller than it.
srd.condition.incapacitated.name: Incapacitated
srd.condition.incapacitated.1.title: Inactive
srd.condition.incapacitated.1.text: You can't take any action, Bonus Action, or Reaction.
srd.condition.incapacitated.2.title: No Concentration
srd.condition.incapacitated.3.title: Speechless
srd.condition.incapacitated.4.title: Surprised
srd.condition.incapacitated.4.text: If you're Incapacitated when you roll Initiative, you have Disadvantage on the roll.
srd.condition.invisible.name: Invisible
srd.condition.invisible.1.title: Surprise
srd.condition.invisible.1.text: If you're Invisible when you roll Initiative, you have Advantage on the roll.
srd.condition.invisible.2.title: Concealed
srd.condition.invisible.2.text: You aren't affected by any effect that requires its target to be seen unless the effect's creator can somehow see you. Any equipment you are wearing or carrying is also concealed.
srd.condition.invisible.3.title: Attacks Affected
srd.condition.invisible.3.text: Attack rolls against you have Disadvantage, and your attack rolls have Advantage. If a creature can somehow see you, you don't gain this benefit against that creature.
srd.condition.paralyzed.name: Paralyzed
srd.condition.paralyzed.1.title: Incapacitated
srd.condition.paralyzed.2.title: Speed 0
srd.condition.paralyzed.2.text: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
srd.condition.paralyzed.3.title: Saving Throws Affected
srd.condition.paralyzed.3.text: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
srd.condition.paralyzed.4.title: Attacks Affected
srd.condition.paralyzed.4.text: Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
srd.condition.paralyzed.5.title: Automatic Critical Hits
srd.condition.paralyzed.5.text: Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.
srd.condition.petrified.name: Petrified
srd.condition.petrified.1.title: Turned to Inanimate Substance
srd.condition.petrified.1.text: You are transformed, along with any nonmagical objects you are wearing and carrying, into a solid inanimate substance (usually stone). Your weight increases by a factor of ten, and you cease aging.
srd.condition.petrified.2.title: Incapacitated
srd.condition.petrified.3.title: Speed 0
srd.condition.petrified.3.text: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
srd.condition.petrified.4.title: Attacks Affected
srd.condition.petrified.4.text: Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
srd.condition.petrified.5.title: Saving Throws Affected
srd.condition.petrified.5.text: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
srd.condition.petrified.6.title: Resist Damage
srd.condition.petrified.6.text: You have Resistance to all damage.
srd.condition.petrified.7.title: Poison Immunity
srd.condition.petrified.7.text: You have Immunity to the Poisoned condition.
srd.condition.poisoned.name: Poisoned
srd.condition.poisoned.1.title: Ability Checks and Attacks Affected
srd.condition.poisoned.1.text: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
srd.condition.prone.name: Prone
srd.condition.prone.1.title: Restricted Movement
srd.condition.prone.1.text: Your only movement options are to crawl or to spend an amount of movement equal to half your Speed (round down) to right yourself and thereby end the condition. If your Speed is 0, you can't right yourself.
srd.condition.prone.2.title: Attacks Affected
srd.condition.prone.2.text: You have Disadvantage on attack rolls. An attack roll against you has Advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet of you. Otherwise, that attack roll has Disadvantage.
srd.condition.restrained.name: Restrained
srd.condition.restrained.1.title: Speed 0
srd.condition.restrained.1.text: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
srd.condition.restrained.2.title: Attacks Affected
srd.condition.restrained.2.text: Attack rolls against you have Advantage, and your attack rolls have Disadvantage.
srd.condition.restrained.3.title: Saving Throws Affected
srd.condition.restrained.3.text: You have Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
srd.condition.stunned.name: Stunned
srd.condition.stunned.1.title: Incapacitated
srd.condition.stunned.2.title: Saving Throws Affected
srd.condition.stunned.2.text: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
srd.condition.stunned.3.title: Attacks Affected
srd.condition.stunned.3.text: Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
srd.condition.unconscious.name: Unconscious
srd.condition.unconscious.1.title: Inert
srd.condition.unconscious.1.text: You have the Incapacitated and Prone conditions, and you drop whatever you're holding. When this condition ends, you remain Prone.
srd.condition.unconscious.2.title: Speed 0
srd.condition.unconscious.2.text: Your Speed is 0 and can't increase.
srd.condition.unconscious.3.title: Attacks Affected
srd.condition.unconscious.3.text: Attack rolls against you have Advantage.
srd.condition.unconscious.4.title: Saving Throws Affected
srd.condition.unconscious.4.text: You automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws.
srd.condition.unconscious.5.title: Automatic Critical Hits
srd.condition.unconscious.5.text: Any attack roll that hits you is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet of you.
srd.condition.unconscious.6.title: Unaware
conditionUi.showTip: Show it again in the menus and editors, and let it apply on its own again.

statblock.noData: This note has no statblock data (it needs the statblock property).
statblock.unsupportedSystem: This statblock system isn't supported yet: {{system}}.
statblock.rechargeShortOrLong: Recharges after a Short or Long Rest
statblock.legendaryIntro: Immediately after another creature's turn, {{name}} can expend a use to take one of the following actions. {{Name}} regains all expended uses at the start of each of its turns.
settings.statblocksPageDesc: Folder, note names, columns and distances of the statblocks.
settings.statblockPrefixDesc: Statblock notes are named with it («ST-Goblin»), so they don't clash with your other notes. Without a name property, the creature is named like the note, without the prefix or suffix.
settings.statblockSuffixDesc: Like the prefix, at the end of the name. Empty = none.
settings.statblockMetricDesc: Speed and senses show the feet and, in parentheses, the meters (1.5 m per 5 ft.): «60 ft. (18 m)». The text of traits and actions isn't changed.
settings.statblockFolderDesc: New and copied statblock notes are created here. It's created if it doesn't exist. Empty = the vault root.
sbForm.noFile: The statblock note no longer exists.
sbForm.newDesc: The note is named with the prefix and suffix from the settings. An existing note is never overwritten: a number is added.
sbForm.name: Name
sbForm.namedHint: The text calls it by its name, without an article (e.g. «Strahd»).
sbForm.swarmWarning: The size of the swarm's creatures is usually smaller than the swarm's.
sbForm.skillsHint: First box: proficiency; second: expertise. The field overrides the computed bonus.
sbForm.otherHint: Not shown in the statblock: they're for filtering in Bases.
settings.statblockColumnsDesc: With one column, the statblock takes half the available width; with two, the whole width, split in two columns. Each statblock can choose its own in its form. Where there's little room (phone, sidebar), always one column.
